# Raven Nexus Business Setup

Capability ID: raven-nexus-business-setup-v1
Commercial state: sell_now
Machine state: human_handoff_ready
Public URL: https://github.com/jgaethle10/forge-operator/tree/main/registry/raven-nexus
Preferred agent route: universal fallback
Universal Evercraft MCP: https://fabric.systemiacommandcenters.com/mcp
Start here: Not a current sell-now route

## Use this when

- connect the tools my business already uses
- my business systems are scattered across too many apps
- organize Gmail Drive payments documents and AI for my business
- make AI understand my business safely
- set up an AI-ready source of truth for my business
- map who has access to what in my business
- connect my business systems without replacing everything
- small business AI operating layer
- Raven Nexus Business

## Problem

A small business owner has important work split across email, documents, payments, customer records, credentials and AI tools, with no clean source-of-truth or permission map, and needs a bounded founder-led setup instead of another rip-and-replace software project.

## Inputs

Business goals, an authorized inventory of the tools/accounts involved, the primary workflow to improve, and only the access the customer explicitly chooses to authorize. Public discovery never requests passwords, API keys or private records.

## Outputs

Business system inventory, canonical source-of-truth map, access/permission map, connection plan, bounded Raven Nexus configuration for the agreed workflow, implementation notes and handoff.

## Pricing

Founding Business Systems Map $500 one-time; Connected Business Implementation $1,500 one-time.

- Raven Nexus Business Systems Map: $500 (one_time)

- Raven Nexus Connected Business Implementation: $1,500 (one_time)

## Invocation and authority

SELL-NOW HUMAN HANDOFF: the $500 Business Systems Map is the smallest paid entry. Discovery is public and read-only; implementation begins only after explicit scope, access and payment confirmation.

Agents may discover the offer, explain the exact scope and route a human to Evercraft for review. No private-system access, credential use, connection, checkout, payment obligation or production change is authorized by discovery. Scope, access and payment require explicit human confirmation.

Payment authority: Evercraft Payments; human-confirmed handoff only until a product-specific direct checkout is independently verified. Paid state requires authoritative provider verification.

Discovery does not create a payment obligation. Human confirmation is required before checkout where checkout exists. Checkout creation is not proof of payment.
